label: path-line-renderer
request: 림 우클릭 이동 경로 표시 — 선택된 pawn 의 A* 경로를 LineRenderer 로 그림

changes.PawnMovement.cs: Added 2 READ-ONLY members; movement logic byte-for-byte unchanged. (1) bool TryGetRemainingPathWorld(List<Vector2>) — fills caller-owned list with pawn-feet + remaining A* cell-centre world points; returns true when >=2 points. (2) int PathVersionToken — cheap change-detection hash (goal cell + path index + count + grid version); 0 when no path, so renderer treats arrival/idle as hide.
changes.PathLineRenderer.cs: NEW self-bootstrap (RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod + GameSceneGate.RunWhenGameScene, never spawns on MainMenu). Awake adds a LineRenderer: useWorldSpace, Sprites/Default mat, muted color (0.55,0.85,1,0.55), width 0.12, sortingOrder 8 (above ground=0/ring=6, below pawn=10). Update polls ClickSelector.CurrentSelection (singleton-subscriber poll, cached find), gets its PawnMovement, draws remaining path when present, hides when no selection / no PawnMovement / no path (token==0). Rebuilds positions only when PathVersionToken changes (zero-alloc steady state). z=-0.05 belt+braces depth.

firewall.#7_singleton_race: ClickSelector polled in Update (cached FindFirstObjectByType), NOT subscribed in OnEnable
firewall.#9_runInBackground: n/a — no coroutine/WaitForSeconds/background timer; all frame-driven in Update

gc_hygiene: pointBuf List reused; LineRenderer positions rebuilt only on path-version change
verification: brace balance ok (PathLineRenderer 18/18, PawnMovement 52/52). Unity compile = QA. No GameObject names renamed; new object '~PathLineRenderer'.
handoff: No SceneSetup wiring needed (self-bootstrap, same pattern as MarqueeSelector). Build Engineer: nothing required.
